info.description:
The Postgres mailing lists and commit history as structured, queryable
data. Every endpoint is `GET`, returns JSON, and requires an API key.

The corpus — pgsql-hackers, pgsql-general, and the rest — plus the
`postgres.git` commit log, indexed for full-text search (synonym- and
plural-aware, noise-filtered) and cross-linked: threads to the commits
that landed them, commits to the discussion that shaped them, patches to
their diffstat, GUCs to the release that changed them.

Authenticate with your key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or
`X-API-Key: <key>`. Register for a key at `/users/register`. Responses
wrap data in a `{ "data": ... }` envelope; keyset-paginated collections
add `next_cursor`/`prev_cursor`. Errors use a `{ "error": { code,
message, details? } }` envelope with a stable `code` slug.
info.title: Horton API
